headline: US localities impose restrictions on data center expansion
summary: Localities in Ohio have approved restrictions on data center development, while the governor-elect of Texas has pledged to maintain a pause on new approvals. These measures threaten the expansion of AI infrastructure in the US.
why: Data centers are the physical backbone of AI and cloud computing. Regulatory hurdles at the local level can increase costs and delay the deployment of critical technology infrastructure.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Regulatory restrictions on infrastructure limit the scalability of AI and cloud services.
